prior_art.basis: Independent review by claude-independent-prior-art-reviewer-20261106: No universal coronavirus vaccine exists, openly or commercially, so the Main KPI of 8,000,000,000 people protected is untouched. The 357 indexed records on universal or pan-coronavirus vaccines are preclinical or modelling: epitope-focused immunogens conferring broad protection (bioRxiv 2026), an engineered HR1-stem-helix-HR2 trimer platform (Adv Sci 2026), receptor-binding-domain-independent conserved T/B epitope fusions (Emerg Microbes Infect 2026), clade 2 and 3 sarbecovirus nanoparticles in hamsters (Vaccine 2026) and heterologous betacoronavirus immunisation in non-human primates (Cell Rep 2026); none reports a licensed product (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/search?query=%22universal%20coronavirus%20vaccine%22%20OR%20%22pan-coronavirus%20vaccine%22&format=json&pageSize=15&resultType=lite). The registry has no pan-coronavirus vaccine trial: an intervention query returns only SARS-CoV-2-specific candidates such as the intranasal OCU500 phase 1 in 80 adults (https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies?query.intr=pan-coronavirus+vaccine&pageSize=20), and the only first-in-human study surfaced by a phase 1 search is a SARS-CoV-2-specific outer-membrane-vesicle intranasal vaccine in 40 seropositive adults (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/search?query=%22pan-coronavirus%22%20AND%20vaccine%20AND%20%28%22phase%201%22%20OR%20%22first-in-human%22%29&format=json&pageSize=5&resultType=core). No open-source candidate or design repository was found (https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=pan-coronavirus+vaccine+design&per_page=10). Honest limit: conserved-epitope immunogen strategies are published in detail, so a task that only restates or re-runs a published immunogen design is a known answer; the open work is correlates of broad protection, durable cross-clade efficacy in humans and a route to global supply.
